implicits.label: Unique implicits
implicits.description: A dropped item gets a unique item's modifier as an extra implicit.

chance.label: One implicit: 1 in
chance.description: The chance of one unique implicit, as 1 in this many drops.

options.label: Wild: any modifier on any gear
Sanity: only modifiers of uniques of the same kind of item
Thematic: modifiers that suit the slot

mode.label: Which modifiers can come
mode.description: Thematic: offence on weapons, quivers and gloves; defence on body armours and shields; speed and ailments on boots; defence and scaling (per charge, per stat, auras) on helmets; utility and odd unique effects on rings, amulets and belts. Jewels get unique jewels' modifiers in every mode, and gear never gets those.

rarityWeights.label: Rarer uniques, rarer modifiers
rarityWeights.description: A modifier of a rare unique (a Mageblood) comes up as seldom as that unique drops. Off: every modifier alike.

empowered.label: Empowered modifier
empowered.description: One of the drop's modifiers, implicit or explicit (a unique implicit included), rolls higher than it can: its value times 1.1 to 2.

percent.label: How much stronger
percent.description: Picked at random in this range for each empowered modifier.

otherItems.label: Also flasks, Heist trinkets and Idols

gemChance.label: Gems: empowered, 1 in
gemChance.description: Of the gems that drop: a level over its cap, or 21% quality or more. 0: never.

gemLevels.label: Gems: levels over the cap
gemLevels.description: 1: a level 20 gem drops at 21. 2 or more needs the private build.

extraModifier.label: Extra fractured modifier
extraModifier.description: The drop gets one modifier more than it could have: a rare 7 (a rare jewel 5), a magic item 3, a unique one rare-style prefix or suffix. Its side (prefixes or suffixes) is fractured.

influencedMods.label: Influenced modifiers too
influencedMods.description: The extra modifier (and the ones that fill the item first) can also be one that only an influenced item rolls: one influence the item does not have is picked, and its modifiers for this base and item level join the pool. The item does not become influenced.

blacklist.label: Modifiers never used as implicits
blacklist.description: A Mods id or the start of one (LevelRequirementOverride), stat: and a piece of a stat id (stat:in_radius), or class: and a kind of item whose uniques' modifiers stay with it (class:UtilityFlask). The defaults are modifiers tied to their own item: radius jewels and tree effects, granted supports by index, effects only that unique has, and flasks', tinctures', maps' and idols' modifiers. Every other unique modifier can come on some kind of item in every mode.

mark.label: Mark exciting items
mark.description: An item with any of these effects gets the Exciting marker (an enchantment with no text that loot filters see, from content/marker.json once the content packs are applied), or drops synthesised without it.

showInFilters.label: Loot filter beam
showInFilters.description: Puts a rule at the top of every loot filter in the filter folder that always shows marked items, with a beam and a sound.

announce.label: Tell me in chat
announce.description: A chat line when an exciting item drops, naming which effects it got (not what they are).

filterFolder.label: Loot filter folder
filterFolder.description: Empty: Documents\My Games\Path of Exile, where the game lists loot filters.

radiantOrb.label: Radiant Orb
radiantOrb.description: A currency of this mod's own (content/radiantorb.json): right-click it, then a magic, rare or unique item, and the item gains one Exciting effect. /exciting orb [n] puts some at your feet.

dropChance.label: Drop chance: 1 in
dropChance.description: Per normal monster killed; magic monsters 3 times as likely, rare 6, unique 10.

anyItem.label: Works on any item
anyItem.description: Also on corrupted, mirrored, fractured, synthesised and influenced items. An item that is already radiant is always refused.

oneImplicit.label: Weight: one unique implicit
oneImplicit.description: How often the orb gives this, against the other results (0: never).

twoImplicits.label: Weight: two unique implicits
twoImplicits.description: How often the orb gives this, against the other results (0: never).

threeImplicits.label: Weight: three unique implicits
threeImplicits.description: How often the orb gives this, against the other results (0: never).

empowered.label: Weight: an empowered modifier
empowered.description: How often the orb gives this, against the other results (0: never).

extra.label: Weight: an extra fractured modifier
extra.description: How often the orb gives this, against the other results (0: never).

legacy.label: Legacy
legacy.description: What the game removed, back (formerly the Legacy Restored mod): Eternal Orbs and Imprints, Labyrinth enchants, alternate quality gems and Regrading Lenses, unnerfs. /legacy for the commands.

unnerfs.label: Unnerfs
unnerfs.description: Skills put back to how they were before a nerf. Turn the whole section off, or one skill.

enabled.label: Unnerfs on
enabled.description: Off: every skill below plays as the current game has it.

cyclone.label: Cyclone (Legion, 3.7)
cyclone.description: Cyclone's radius grows with its stages again: up to 3 at gem level 1 and 6 at gem level 20, each one a step wider.

cycloneStages.label: Cyclone: most stages
cycloneStages.description: The stages a level 20 Cyclone reaches (3.7 had 6). A level 1 gem reaches half of them.

cycloneRadiusPerStage.label: Cyclone: radius per stage
cycloneRadiusPerStage.description: How much wider each stage makes Cyclone (3.7: 1; the skill's own radius is 16).

enabled.label: Eternal Orbs drop
enabled.description: Monsters of level 40 and up can drop Eternal Orbs. Use one on an item to keep an imprint of it; /legacy imprints lists them and /legacy restore puts one back.

rarity.label: Rarer than a Divine Orb
rarity.description: How many times rarer than a Divine Orb an Eternal Orb is.

enabled.label: Enchant currency drops
enabled.description: Monsters can drop the Enchant currency. Use it on a helmet, gloves, boots or a belt for a random Labyrinth enchantment, which replaces the one it has.

weight.label: Drop weight
weight.description: How often it drops beside the other currency: a Divine Orb is 1, an Exalted Orb 2, a Regal Orb 20, a Chaos Orb 40.

tier.label: Enchantment tier
tier.description: Which Labyrinth's enchantments the currency gives. Helmets have only Merciless and Eternal ones.

skillEffects.label: Helmet enchantments change skills
skillEffects.description: An enchantment that names a skill (40% increased Fireball Damage) is applied to that skill through the game's own table of skill-specific stats. Off: such enchantments are shown but do nothing.

labyrinthOnly.label: Only in the Labyrinth
labyrinthOnly.description: Enchants drop only in the Labyrinth: from its monsters, and from its chests (below).

labyrinthChest.label: Labyrinth chests: 1 in
labyrinthChest.description: How many of the Labyrinth's chests hold one Enchant, as 1 in this many.

enabled.label: Alternate quality gems
enabled.description: Anomalous, Divergent and Phantasmal gems as they were in 3.22. The gem's tooltip cannot show the alternate quality line: chat tells you when one drops and /legacy gems lists the ones you have.

anywhere.label: Drop from any monster
anywhere.description: Off: only unique monsters drop them.

dropRate.label: Share of gem drops
dropRate.description: For every gem a monster would drop, the chance of an alternate quality gem as well.

uniqueChance.label: Unique monsters: extra chance
uniqueChance.description: The chance a unique monster drops one, on top of the share above.

lensWeight.label: Regrading Lens drop weight
lensWeight.description: Prime (skill gems) and Secondary (support gems) Regrading Lenses change a gem's quality type to another one. Each drops with this weight: a Divine Orb is 1. 0: they do not drop.

influenceLook.label: Show the quality type as an influence
influenceLook.description: The gem's tooltip cannot show its alternate quality, so the gem carries an influence to tell it apart: Anomalous is Shaper, Divergent is Elder, Phantasmal is Crusader. Type /legacy gems to update gems you already have in your backpack.

announce.label: Tell me in chat
announce.description: A chat line when one of this mod's items drops or is used.

testCommands.label: Test commands
testCommands.description: /legacy give ... puts this mod's items on the ground for testing.

limitBreakOrb.label: Limit Break Orb
limitBreakOrb.description: A currency of this mod's own (content/limitbreakorb.json): one more socket than the item could have, up to the most below. The game's own socket limits stay as they are, so this orb is the only way past them.

enabled.label: Limit Break Orbs drop and work

dropChance.label: Drop chance: 1 in
dropChance.description: Per normal monster killed; magic monsters 3 times as likely, rare 6, unique 10.

linkNew.label: The new socket is linked
linkNew.description: On: it joins the item's last link group. Off: it comes unlinked, for a Fusing to link.

krangleOrb.label: Krangle Orb
krangleOrb.description: A currency of this mod's own (content/krangleorb.json): the Blood Crucible's and Dream Furnace's transform. The item or map becomes corrupted and gets one Scourge upside and one downside, replacing a pair it had.

dropChance.label: Drop chance: 1 in
dropChance.description: Per normal monster killed; magic monsters 3 times as likely, rare 6, unique 10.

tier4.label: Tier 4: 1 in
tier4.description: Of the transforms at item level 68 or more, how many are tier 4 (the strongest upsides).

rarities.label: Items it works on
rarities.description: The Blood Crucible took rares (uniques with a skill of its tree).

legacyMods.label: Legacy affixes
legacyMods.description: Modifiers that could roll in an older patch (3.9 to 3.19 data, and ones that no longer roll at all) and no longer do, such as item quantity on amulets and rings. The list is legacymods.json in this mod's folder: remove a line to stop one. They do not make an item exciting.

chance.label: Chance per item: 1 in
chance.description: Of the magic and rare drops that can take one.

replace.label: Replace an affix when the item is full
replace.description: Off: a full item only gets one on its free side.

mark.label: Legacy mark
mark.description: The item gets the Legacy mark, and the loot filters show it with an orange border and an orange beam (needs content/legacymarker.json applied).

recombinators.label: Recombinators
recombinators.description: The Sentinel league's Armour, Weapon and Jewellery Recombinators, as strong as in 3.18. Use one on an item, then on a second item of the same class: both are destroyed and one is made from their properties. Each later change (nerf) is a switch below, off by default.

armourDrop.label: Armour Recombinator drop chance: 1 in
armourDrop.description: Per normal monster killed; magic 3 times as likely, rare 6, unique 10. 0: never.

mirrored.label: Combine mirrored items
mirrored.description: 3.18: yes (the result is not mirrored). 3.19 stopped it.

averageItemLevel.label: Item level is the two items' average
averageItemLevel.description: 3.18: the average. 3.30: the chosen base's own.

sentinelChance.label: Sentinel modifier: 1 in
sentinelChance.description: 3.18: about 1 in 50 results got one of the 52 Sentinel-only modifiers (keystones on body armours, +1 maximum charges on rings ...). 0: never (3.25).

tierUp.label: Chance a modifier goes up a tier (%)
tierUp.description: 3.18 moved tiers up or down at random; 3.25 stopped it.

tierDown.label: Chance a modifier goes down a tier (%)

keepFractured.label: Fractured modifiers stay fractured
keepFractured.description: 3.18: up to 6 fractured modifiers on one item.

modGroups.label: Two modifiers of one group cannot both be kept
modGroups.description: Off: as 3.18's bug, which 3.19 fixed, sometimes allowed.

nativeOnly.label: Nerf: only modifiers the base can roll
nativeOnly.description: 3.25: a modifier the chosen base could not roll is dropped (spell suppression on a strength base ...).

nonNativeCount.label: Nerf off: dropped modifiers still count
nonNativeCount.description: With the nerf above: on, they still raise the number of modifiers (3.25); off, they do not (3.30).

oneExclusive.label: Nerf: only one exclusive modifier
oneExclusive.description: 3.25: one crafted, essence, veiled, delve, incursion or breach modifier at most.

fracturedNeedsFracturedBase.label: Nerf: fractured modifiers need a fractured base

defiledOrb.label: Defiled Vaal Orb
defiledOrb.description: A currency of this mod's own (content/defiledorb.json): corrupts a corrupted item a second time. Gems can reach two levels over their cap (22) or have their quality moved again; gear can get a second corrupted implicit or another Vaal Orb outcome; a map, jewel or flask that dropped corrupted gets a Vaal Orb's outcome.

enabled.label: Defiled Vaal Orbs drop and work

sideAreaMonsters.label: Vaal side area monsters: 1 in
sideAreaMonsters.description: Magic 3 times as likely, rare 6, unique 10. 0: never.

vessel.label: Vaal side area chests (the vessel at the end): 1 in

corruptedMapMonsters.label: Monsters in corrupted maps: 1 in
corruptedMapMonsters.description: While Vaal side areas do not work.

levelsOver.label: Gem levels over the cap it can reach

quality.label: Gem: quality up or down by 1 to 10 (weight)

mostCorruptedImplicits.label: Most corrupted implicits on one item

reflectingMist.label: Reflecting Mist
reflectingMist.description: The server has no use of its own for Reflecting Mist: this mod gives it one. The item becomes two mirrored halves; each explicit modifier's values are multiplied by one roll, positive on one half and reflected (negative) on the other. content/reflectingmist.json lets the client offer it on any magic, rare or unique item.

dropChance.label: Drop chance: 1 in
dropChance.description: Per monster killed of the kind below; magic 3 times as likely, rare 6, unique 10. 0: never.

minPercent.label: Smallest modifier effect (%)
minPercent.description: 3.29: 130 to 160 in steps of 1. Before 3.29: 150 to 210 in steps of 2.5.

maxPercent.label: Largest modifier effect (%)
maxPercent.description: 250 for more variance, and so on.

balanced.label: Chance the halves split evenly (%)
balanced.description: The game's: about 92% of 6-modifier items split 3 and 3.

jackpot.label: Jackpots
jackpot.description: Now and then a drop gets several exciting effects at once: a unique implicit, an empowered modifier, an extra fractured modifier and a legacy affix (magic and rare items) and a custom implicit, drawn from those the item can take. On top of the ordinary rolls, which can already land together by chance.

two.label: 2 effects at once: 1 in
two.description: Per magic, rare or unique drop. 0: never.

customImplicits.label: Custom implicits
customImplicits.description: New implicits built from effect rules (a trigger and an effect, such as "8% chance to gain Onslaught for 4 seconds on Critical Strike"), about 100 per gear slot, each slot with its own kind of effects: damage on weapons and gloves, movement and cleansing on boots, buffs and curses on helmets and shields, defences on body armours, flasks on belts. A roll of their own, apart from the unique implicits. Needs the private build and content/customimplicits.json applied.

chance.label: Chance per drop: 1 in
chance.description: Of the magic, rare and unique drops of the rarities below.

most.label: Custom implicits per roll
most.description: One for now: every custom implicit uses the same pair of item stats (the game cannot take new ones).

anySlot.label: Any implicit on any slot
anySlot.description: Off: each slot rolls its own list. On: every slot rolls from all of them.

options.label: Onslaught, Arcane Surge, Phasing, Unholy Might
Life, Mana and Energy Shield recovery
On Hitting a Rare or Unique
On Killing a Rare or Unique
When Hit by a Critical Strike
When you use a Life Flask
When you use a Mana Flask
When you use a Utility Flask
When you use a Movement Skill

ignoreItemLevel.label: Any tier at any item level

valueScale.label: Values (% of the rolled numbers)
valueScale.description: 200 doubles every custom implicit's number. The text shows the scaled number.

inJackpots.label: Can be one of a jackpot's effects

blacklist.label: Never roll (words)
blacklist.description: Lines whose id or text has one of these words, such as "Freeze" or "curse_".

flaskChance.label: Flasks: a custom implicit, 1 in
flaskChance.description: Of the flasks that drop (any rarity): one of 214 flask implicits that act when the flask is used, during its effect ("During Effect, ..."), or give a unique's effect during it (Headhunter's and 69 more). Marked, so loot filters show them. 0: never.

rarityWeights.label: Better effects are rarer
rarityWeights.description: A unique's effect is as likely as that unique is to drop, as the unique implicits on gear are. Off: every effect as likely.

legacyUniques.label: Legacy uniques
legacyUniques.description: Old versions of uniques (Kaom's Heart before 1.0.0, Bramblejack before 3.19.0 ...) and uniques the game removed, from Path of Building's records (legacyuniques.json: 819 uniques, 692 with old versions, 163 removed). They drop from bosses.

overrides.label: Versions per unique
overrides.description: A unique's name to the version it drops as (as /exciting legacyuniques lists them: "Pre 3.25.0"), or random or newest. The others follow the setting above.

oldVersions.label: Old versions of uniques still in the game

mark.label: Legacy mark
mark.description: The item gets the Legacy mark: the loot filters show it with an orange border and beam.

announce.label: Say in chat when one drops

blacklist.label: Never drop (names or parts of names)

legacyCurrencies.label: Legacy currencies
legacyCurrencies.description: Currencies the game no longer drops: Harbinger's (Orb of Binding, Ancient Orb, Orb of Horizons, Harbinger's Orb, shards), Scourge's Tainted ones and the Orb of Dominance. The server already uses most of them; this mod gives Orb of Horizons, Harbinger's Orb, Tainted Mythic Orb, Tainted Divine Teardrop and Orb of Dominance their use (private build). Eternal Orbs and Enchants are in the legacy group.

monsters.label: Monster drop chances: 1 in
monsters.description: A currency's name to 1 in this many normal monsters (magic 3 times as likely, rare 6, unique 10). 0 or removing a line: never. Any stackable currency the client has can be added.

strongboxes.label: Strongbox drop chances: 1 in
strongboxes.description: A currency's name to 1 in this many strongboxes opened (private build).

uses.label: Uses for the five without one
uses.description: Orb of Horizons (another map of its tier), Harbinger's Orb (a map of the next tier), Tainted Mythic Orb (a corrupted rare becomes a corrupted unique), Tainted Divine Teardrop (a modifier of a corrupted item moves a tier), Orb of Dominance (elevates an influenced modifier).

horizonsKeepsMods.label: Orb of Horizons keeps the map's modifiers

teardropDowngrade.label: Tainted Divine Teardrop: chance to go down a tier instead (%)

mythicSameClass.label: Tainted Mythic Orb: any unique of the item's class
mythicSameClass.description: Off: only uniques of the same base type.

dominanceRemoves.label: Orb of Dominance removes another influenced modifier
dominanceRemoves.description: As the game did. Off: it only elevates.

announce.label: Say in chat when one drops

crucible.label: Crucible trees (pre-rolled)
crucible.description: Crucible's weapon tree nodes, from the client's own data (2,632 nodes in five columns). The server cannot send a tree to choose from, so an item gets a path of nodes already allocated, one per column, for its kind of item and item level. Their lines show as enchantments by default.

chance.label: Chance per weapon or shield drop: 1 in

uniques.label: Uniques too
uniques.description: Crucible's forge put trees on uniques.

notableChance.label: Chance a node is a notable (%)

ignoreItemLevel.label: Any node tier at any item level

idols.label: Idols
idols.description: Legacy of Phrecia's Idols from more places, each with its own chance (1 in X; 0: never). They go in the Idol inventory (the map device's storage grid in the Atlas screen's side panel) when the server's Idols module is on in your league, and work beside the scarabs in the device. Now and then an Idol has a scarab's effect as an implicit.

uniqueShare.label: Unique Idols: 1 in
uniqueShare.description: Of the Idols that drop. 0: never.

scarabImplicit.label: A scarab's effect as an implicit: 1 in
scarabImplicit.description: Of the Idols that drop: one of the 198 scarab effects' own map modifiers on the Idol. 0: never.

scarabImplicitMost.label: Scarab effects on such an Idol

unidentified.label: Drop unidentified
unidentified.description: As the game's: an unidentified Idol does nothing until identified.

announce.label: Say in chat when one drops

excitingImplicit.label: Exciting Idols: 1 in
excitingImplicit.description: Of the Idols that drop: one of 182 map modifiers (old leaguestones, Atlas sextants and other map modifiers) that change maps in fun ways (more Rogue Exiles, Strongboxes with Rare Items, extra Shrines, Harbingers, Essences, Tormented Spirits ...) as an implicit, and the Exciting mark. 0: never.

excitingImplicitMost.label: Fun map modifiers on such an Idol

excitingBlacklist.label: Never on Idols (words)
excitingBlacklist.description: Map modifiers whose stat or text has one of these words (idolimplicits.json lists them).

excitingWeights.label: Better ones are rarer
excitingWeights.description: Atlas sextant modifiers keep their old sextant weights (a Winged Scarab's 50 against a Rusted's 520); the others are as likely as the most common. Off: all as likely.

mirage.label: Mirage
mirage.description: What the Mirage league left that the server can use (its Mirage encounters are not built): The Black Barya, which opens Saresh, of the Weeping Black's arena in the map device, Saresh's Mirage uniques, and Screams of the Desiccated with two shrine buffs. Each chance is 1 in X; 0: never.

mapsOnly.label: The Black Barya drops in maps only

baryaBosses.label: The Black Barya from bosses (unique monsters): 1 in

baryaRare.label: The Black Barya from rare monsters: 1 in

baryaStrongboxes.label: The Black Barya from strongboxes: 1 in

baryaFaridunExiles.label: The Black Barya from Faridun Rogue Exiles: 1 in

sareshUnique.label: Saresh drops a Mirage unique: 1 in
sareshUnique.description: One of the 13, as likely as each drops elsewhere (Screams of the Desiccated and The Sands of Time the rarest).

bossMirageUnique.label: Other bosses drop a Mirage unique: 1 in

screamsTwoShrines.label: Screams of the Desiccated has two shrine buffs
screamsTwoShrines.description: The server's data has only its first version (always Acceleration Shrine).

anyShrines.label: Any two of its thirteen shrines
anyShrines.description: On (a buff): any two different ones (Divine Shrine was never one of them). Off: as the game did, one offensive shrine and one other.

announce.label: Say in chat when one drops

unobtainable.label: Unobtainable uniques aquirable?
unobtainable.description: Uniques the server has no working source for yet (295 when this was made: their league content, boss or card isn't built, such as Heist's Replicas, Sanctum, the Incursion temple, Abyssal Depths, Breach lords, Delve, Ancestor and race rewards) drop from the normal drops, bosses, Rogue Exiles and strongboxes instead. One the server starts dropping normally leaves the list by itself. Each chance is 1 in X; 0: never.

inPlaceOf.label: A unique that drops is one of these instead: 1 in
inPlaceOf.description: Puts them in the normal drop pool without more uniques dropping overall.

pinnacles.label: Pinnacle bosses drop one: 1 in
pinnacles.description: The Shaper, the Elder, the Maven, Sirus, the Eater of Worlds, the Searing Exarch, Atziri and uber bosses.

mapsOnly.label: Bosses, Rogue Exiles and strongboxes in maps only
mapsOnly.description: The in-place-of chance works everywhere either way.

heist.label: Heist: Replicas and Curio Display uniques

sanctum.label: Sanctum: Lycia's uniques and the relics

race.label: Race and event rewards
race.description: Demigod's items, Star of Wraeclast, Talisman of the Victor. The real game never dropped these.

idols.label: Unique idols
idols.description: The Idols part drops these already.

other.label: All the others
other.description: League uniques such as the Incursion temple's, Abyssal Depths', the Breach lords', Delve's, Ancestor's and Betrayal's.

extra.label: Also these (unique names)
extra.description: Any unique, even one that drops normally.

rarityWeights.label: Rarer uniques are rarer
rarityWeights.description: Each weighs what the server's drop tables give it; off: all weigh the same.

defaultWeight.label: Weight of one with no weight of its own (or all, with the setting above off)

announce.label: Say in chat when one drops

cardRate.label: Divination cards
cardRate.description: How often divination cards drop, every card in every area (The Doctor in Burial Chambers too), from monsters, chests and strongboxes.

dropChance.label: Card drop chance
dropChance.description: How often a kill drops a divination card: 1 as the server has it, 3 three times as often, 0.5 half as often. Each card still drops one at a time.

perCardChance.label: One card's own chance (card name: factor)
perCardChance.description: How much likelier that card is to be the one that drops, e.g. "The Doctor": 5.

multiplier.label: Copies of each card that drops
multiplier.description: Not the chance: every card that drops comes this many times (2: two of it). 1: one, as the server has it.

perCard.label: One card's own copies (card name: copies)
perCard.description: Over the copies above, e.g. "The Doctor": 2.

ascendantJewels.label: Ascendant jewels
ascendantJewels.description: Jewels that drop with "Allocates <ascendancy passive>" implicits: the node works while the jewel sits in an allocated tree socket, on any class (needs the server's jewel-allocates part). A node that asks you to pick rolls as one of its options, named on the jewel.

jewelChance.label: Chance a jewel that drops anyway gets nodes (0.02 = 2%)

abyssChance.label: Chance an abyss jewel that drops anyway gets nodes

clusterChance.label: Chance a cluster jewel that drops anyway gets nodes
clusterChance.description: A cluster jewel in an open cluster socket counts too.

secondChance.label: Jewels that drop anyway: chance of two nodes

thirdChance.label: Jewels that drop anyway: chance of three nodes
thirdChance.description: Part of the chance for two: 0.15 and 0.03 make 12% two and 3% three.

phrecia.label: Phrecia ascendancies' nodes
phrecia.description: Their own nodes (Aristocrat, Polytheist, Surfcaster...), in every league. The Harbinger's companion summons stay out: only the Phrecia league runs them.

unused.label: Nodes the game no longer uses ([UNUSED])
unused.description: Old nodes still in the game data. Some may do little or nothing.

notablesOnly.label: Notables only
notablesOnly.description: Off: the small ascendancy nodes can roll too.

uniques.label: Unique jewels can get them too

mapsOnly.label: Jewels that drop anyway: only in maps

chests.label: Jewels that drop anyway: from chests and strongboxes too

announce.label: Say so in chat when one drops

normalWeight.label: Weight of a normal ascendancy node

specialWeight.label: Weight of a Reliquarian or Luminary node

blacklist.label: Never roll these
blacklist.description: Node names or ascendancy names (Juggernaut, Polytheist...).

weights.label: Own weights
weights.description: By node name (its weight) or ascendancy name (multiplies its nodes' weight): Unbreakable 5, Surfcaster 0.5.

sources.label: Ascendant jewels: where they drop of their own
sources.description: New jewels from each source, each with its own chance for one, two and three nodes. Three is tried first, then two, then one: at most one jewel per kill or chest.

one.label: 1 in N: a jewel with one node (0: never)

two.label: 1 in N: a jewel with two nodes (0: never)

three.label: 1 in N: a jewel with three nodes (0: never)

minTier.label: Lowest map tier (0: anywhere)
minTier.description: Above 0: only in maps of that tier or higher (16: T16 and up).

one.label: 1 in N: a jewel with one node (0: never)

two.label: 1 in N: a jewel with two nodes (0: never)

three.label: 1 in N: a jewel with three nodes (0: never)

minTier.label: Lowest map tier (0: anywhere)
minTier.description: Above 0: only in maps of that tier or higher (16: T16 and up).

one.label: 1 in N: a jewel with one node (0: never)

two.label: 1 in N: a jewel with two nodes (0: never)

three.label: 1 in N: a jewel with three nodes (0: never)
